record: National Register of Historic Places district nomination, section 7
facts: Building 832 originally served as the guardhouse and was converted to the Adjutant’s Office and Library. Separate Building 831 was erected farther east and set back, with its porch largely enclosed in the 1930s.

record: 2023 New Mexico Historic Preservation Division cultural landscape inventory
facts: The Adjutant’s Office was erected around 1866 and gained an upper shingle-clad story with two-story porch before 1901. The Second Guard House dates from about 1876, with a former open porch facing the parade ground.
Identifies the parade-ground collection and the guard house and adjutant’s office among the surviving fort buildings.
